product_one_liner.value: Kojo helps trade and self-perform general contractors manage materials procurement and inventory by connecting field, office, warehouse, accounting, and distributor teams on one platform.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes included services and unlimited users and data; pricing requires a custom quote.

employee_band.notes: Based on a reported LinkedIn employee count of 163.

eng_blog.notes: Only one qualifying product-engineering post was found: “Rebranding to Kojo — and solving tech debt along the way!” The other identified engineer-authored post concerns team leadership, not how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes authentication, API limits, standards, GraphQL and REST references, and SCIM; a separate customer help center also exists.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists two openings: Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst; neither is a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models
model_provider.notes: Named in Kojo's Intelligence Layer announcement.

compliance_certs.notes: Kojo states that it successfully completed a SOC 2 audit.

last_funding.notes: Latest identified round: $10 million invested by Wesco International, announced October 16, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 16, 2025 Series C extension falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither listed opening—Demand Gen Lead or Revenue Operations Support Analyst—is an SDR, BDR, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest qualifying launch identified was the Access Coins Evo integration on April 28, 2026, before the May 9 cutoff. August release notes describe incremental permissions, workflow, visibility, and interface changes rather than a new product or major feature.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Co-founder Micah Rodman's profile dates the start of his CEO role to January 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Revenue Operations Support Analyst posting explicitly says Kojo's Sales and Customer Success teams run on Salesforce.
